source.title: CoFID
source.attribution: Public Health England (2021). McCance and Widdowson’s The Composition of Foods Integrated Dataset (CoFID). Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
source.modifications: Selected subset; reviewed simplified Chinese names, aliases and frozen pinyin initials; trace values approximated as zero only for numeric calculation; salt calculated from sodium; original 12 installation values preserved independently of source projection.

review.method: Each selected source name and its raw/cooked, edible-part and preparation qualifiers were checked against the frozen Chinese label and aliases during development. No nutritional values were generated.
review.independentHumanSignoff: Pending user catalog spot-check and acceptance; development review is not an independent human certification.
review.limitations: Generic animal ingredients do not certify halal procurement. Source descriptions do not establish a specific local product recipe or species beyond what the English name states.
review.independentDevelopmentReview: A second agent read all 358 initial code/name/originalName/state/alias/pinyin records, identified six wording/basis issues plus three initials, and confirmed no explicit pork/alcohol/gelatine entries. The changes were incorporated and the unresolved corn-flour candidate was removed; final total 357. This remains development review, not human certification.
